items.title: CEO 醜聞的成本通常約為 1%。這就是 Nvidia 的不同之處
items.summary: 關鍵要點 英偉達 (NVDA) 在截至 11 月 13 日的一周內下跌了近 13%，由於黃仁勳的辭職加劇了人們對人工智慧支出週期的擔憂，其連續下跌趨勢延長至六週。史丹佛大學的研究人員發現，38 起 CEO 不當行為事件導致經市場調整的股票跌幅中位數僅 1。
items.originalTitle: CEO Scandals Typically Cost About 1%. Here’s Why It’s Different for Nvidia
items.originalSummary: Key TakeawaysNvidia (NVDA) fell nearly 13% during the week ending November 13, extending its losing streak to six weeks as Jensen Huang’s resignation added to concerns about the AI spending cycle. Stanford researchers found that 38 CEO misconduct incidents produced a median market-adjusted stock decline of just 1.

Cameron County commissioners blocked moving ahead with talks on a requested property tax break for SpaceX’s proposed data center and natural gas power plant, according to local outlet KRGV . It was seeking a 100 percent property tax abatement for 10 years, said The Brownsville Herald , but the measure failed in a 3-2 vote. Planned data centers emerged as a significant issue in races and ballot contests across the country during the recent midterm elections. Residents nationwide had raised concerns about their potential impact on electricity bills, water consumption and noise disrupting nearby neighborhoods.

historyItems.originalTitle: Microsoft and Salesforce Announce Copilotforce, Bringing Trusted Customer Context and Action into Microsoft AI Experiences
historyItems.originalSummary: REDMOND, Wash., and SAN FRANCISCO — Nov. 17, 2026 — Microsoft Corp. (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce Inc. (NYSE: CRM) today announced Copilotforce, a new partnership that helps employees get more done in the tools they already use by bringing Salesforce customer context, business processes and actions into Microsoft Copilot and other AI-powered productivity experiences. Unveiled at Microsoft Ignite, the partnership introduces new integrations across Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Fabric, including Salesforce in Copilot, a plugin available in public preview with 38+ prebuilt sales skills. Together, these capabilities help businesses move faster, reduce manual work and get more value from their existing technology investments — while maintaining the security, governance and permissions they already rely on. Bringing Salesforce workflows together with conversations, meetings and documents in Microsoft 365 means less time spent moving between systems and more time on the work that matters. Salesforce in Copilot connects customer context with the work happening across the business so employees can make more informed decisions and take action without constantly switching applications. Microsoft Work IQ, the intelligence layer powering Copilot, provides relevant context from Teams meetings, Outlook emails and documents across SharePoint and OneDrive. Work IQ and Salesforce help sellers understand not only what’s recorded in CRM, but what’s happening across customer conversations and collaboration — and what needs to happen next. Through authenticated Salesforce MCP access, sellers can securely retrieve customer information and take supported business actions within their existing Salesforce permissions. Salesforce continues to govern access and business actions, while Microsoft applies its existing enterprise compliance controls to communications and documents. Data, context and the apps where sellers work come to life in practical workflows across the sales cycle, including: With Copilot as the front door to business process, Salesforce in Copilot allows organizations to bring together Salesforce data, workflows, agents and prebuilt skills from the systems they already rely on through Copilot’s open and interoperable platform. “Through Copilotforce, we’re bringing Salesforce to the largest surface in enterprise software today, embedding trusted Salesforce context and intelligent sales workflows directly where sellers work,” said Miguel Milano, President & Chief Operating Officer, Salesforce . “By bringing together the #1 CRM with the #1 productivity surface, we’re transforming AI from a standalone tool into a powerful driver of productivity, smarter decisions and customer success.” Expanding connection in the places people work For many organizations, the work first starts in Microsoft Teams, where people share files, make decisions and hand work to each other. If you’re on the fence about investing in Amkor Technology, Inc., Aehr Test Systems or Inc. because you’re not sure how they measure up, it’s important to compare them on a few factors before making your decision. Read on to learn how Amkor Technology, Inc., Aehr Test Systems and Inc. compare based on key financial metrics to determine which better meets your investment needs. About Amkor Technology, Inc., Aehr Test Systems and Inc. Amkor Technology, Inc. provides outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services in the United States, Japan, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It offers turnkey packaging and test services, including semiconductor wafer bump, wafer probe, wafer back-grind, package design, packaging, burn-in, system-level and final test, and drop shipment services; flip chip scale package products for smartphones, tablets, and other mobile consumer electronic devices; flip chip stacked chip scale packages that are used to stack memory digital baseband, and as applications processors in mobile devices; flip-chip ball grid array packages for various networking, storage, computing, automotive, and consumer applications; and memory products for system memory or platform data storage. The company provides wafer-level CSP packages for power management, transceivers, sensors, wireless charging, codecs, and specialty silicon; wafer-level fan-out packages used in power management, transceivers, radar, and specialty silicon; silicon wafer integrated fan-out technology that replaces a laminate substrate with a thinner structure; leadframe packages for electronic devices and mixed-signal applications; and substrate-based wirebond packages used to connect a die to a substrate. In addition, it offers micro-electro-mechanical systems packages that are miniaturized mechanical and electromechanical devices; and advanced system-in-package modules used in radio frequency and front end modules, basebands, connectivity, fingerprint sensors, display and touch screen drivers, sensors and MEMS, and NAND memory and solid-state drives. Further, the company provides wafer, package, and system level test services, as well as burn-in test and test development services. It serves integrated device manufacturers, fabless semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers, and contract foundries. Amkor Technology, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona. historyItems.originalTitle: Doug's 2026-27 Winter Weather Outlook: How much snow will the DC area get?
historyItems.originalSummary: As a beautiful fall winds down, FOX 5 NY's Nick Gregory is sharing his 2026-2027 winter outlook, which is shaping up to be a lot milder than last season, when nearly 60 inches of snow fell in New York City. JUMP TO: FIRST DAY OF WINTER l ‘SUPER EL NIÑO’ l SNOW TOTAL PREDICTIONSWinter forecasts this year come down to four key indicators: Winter officially begins in the Northern Hemisphere on Dec. 21 with the winter solstice – the day with the least amount of possible daylight and the longest night.El Niño refers to warmer-than-average sea surface temperatures along the equatorial latitude in the Pacific Ocean.It causes an intensified southern jet stream that forces the polar jet stream to retreat further into southern Canada. The results are milder, dry conditions in the northern U.S. and a cool, wetter-than-normal forecast for the southern part of the country.This year, we're experiencing a "Super El Niño," with water temperatures rising to a historic 4.77°F above average, outpacing each of the four previous "Super El Niño" years of 2015, 1997, 1982 and 1877. A strong El Niño winter doesn't automatically mean there won't be snow. It tends to bring more coastal storms along the Eastern Seaboard, but the above-average temperatures mean rain is more likely.El Niño can still cause a variety of outcomes. In 2015-2016, the region saw a total of 31.2" of snow, but 27.5" came from one blockbuster storm in January 2016.Here are the other previous totals:Gregory describes the polar vortex as a high-speed "racetrack wind pattern" that circles the North Pole when stable. If it becomes fractured or weakened, arctic air can spill down into the eastern U.S. The polar vortex weakened in early November this year, which has never happened for as long as forecasters have been tracking it. This is worth keeping an eye on. The North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) is a pressure oscillation that stretches from the North Atlantic down to the subtropical Atlantic.When in its negative phase, the NAO forms a blocking pattern around Greenland that forces cold air down from Canada, resulting in coastal storms. In the past, this has caused some major snowstorms in the New York City area. In its positive phase, the NAO sees much stronger pressure variation in the Atlantic, resulting in a stronger westerly wind. Cold air stays north, keeping temperatures mild around here. Arctic, or Siberian, snow cover started early this year. In fact, it's already above average. What does that mean? Colder air can more easily travel across the North Pole, disrupt the polar vortex and send more cold air into the eastern U.S. Gregory predicts there will be multiple coastal storms this winter, but with a lower-than-average amount of snow. Since the super El Niño leads to milder temperatures, the storms can vary between snow, ice and rain along the coast. You'll probably have to be well inland to get a good amount of snow this year.Gregory predicts New York City and the nearby suburbs could see 12-20" of snow this year, but he notes that might be too generous, all things considered. historyItems.title: FAA 空中交通地面站調查：HPE Juniper 路由器、Cisco 路由器以及電信網路升級的後果
historyItems.summary: 以下是電信網路升級，涉及從已有 20 年歷史的 Cisco 路由器遷移到現代 HPE Juniper 路由器，從而導致上週五全國範圍內的空中交通地面停止。美國交通部長 Sean Duffy 在接受 CNBC 採訪時表示，上週五，美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 全國空中交通地面站進行了電信網路升級，其中包括從使用了 20 年的思科路由器升級為現代的 HPE Juniper 路由器，現在正將注意力集中在較舊的思科設備上。 「當我們在阿肯色州埃爾多拉多進行其中一次切換時，伺服器或路由器開始淹沒我們的網絡，」達菲週一在談到從舊銅線到光纖的網路升級時說道。
historyItems.originalTitle: FAA Air Traffic Ground Stop Investigation: HPE Juniper Routers, Cisco Routers, And The Aftermath Of A Telecom Network Upgrade
historyItems.originalSummary: Here’s a look at how a telecom network upgrade involving a move from 20-year-old Cisco routers to modern HPE Juniper routers led to the nationwide air traffic ground stop last Friday. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) nationwide air traffic ground stop last Friday, which resulted from a telecom network upgrade involving a move from 20-year-old Cisco routers to modern HPE Juniper routers, is now zeroing in on older Cisco equipment, said U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy in an interview on CNBC. “What happened was as we did one of those switchovers in El Dorado, Ark., that server or that router started to flood our network,” said Duffy Monday of the network upgrade from old copper wires to fiber. “Well, all of the work I had done to put in new equipment, those routers in my system didn’t go down. But we also use a lot of 2001 Cisco servers that went out of commission in 2006. It is those old servers that were flooded and started to give us inconsistency in our network.” At this point, Duffy said, the Cisco server in question has been taken to federal contractor and technology solution provider L3Harris Technologies’ Florida laboratory as part of an investigation into the incident with FAA staff on site. CRN reached out to Cisco for comment but had not heard back at press time. As a result of the network issue, Duffy said the decision was made to “shut down the airspace” until the U.S. could “isolate where the flooding of the network was coming from, remedy it, get the systems working again and get air travel back to normal,” said Duffy. In a press conference on Saturday, Federal Aviation Administrator Bryan Bedford told reporters that the FAA spends a billion dollars a year maintaining and sustaining its 1980s TDMI telco network, which he referred to as a 1G system. “We are constantly replacing 2,000 Cisco 600 routers with Juniper routers,” he said. “So, this is ordinary course-of-business stuff.” Those Cisco 600 routers were manufactured between 2001 and 2006. The upgrade from Cisco routers to HPE Juniper equipment was being conducted by Melbourne, Fla.-based L3Harris, which is under contract with the U.S. government, runs the telecom network. L3Harris, which has been working with the FAA for over 20 years, is now under scrutiny on whether there was a misconfiguration issue with regard to the HPE Juniper router as part of the network upgrade.

historyItems.originalTitle: Mistakes were made in AI data center rollout, Oracle CEO tells Detroit crowd
historyItems.originalSummary: Oracle stock fell approximately 4% during Tuesday’s US trading session as investors assessed a Bloomberg report that HSBC sold roughly $300 million of construction debt tied to Oracle’s Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico at a substantial discount. The transaction, completed several weeks ago but disclosed on November 16, adds to concerns about the financing costs and construction risks associated with Oracle’s expanding AI infrastructure business. Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) traded at $114.34 at 12:05 p.m. ET on November 17, down 3.99% from Monday’s $119.09 close. The shares had already declined 4.99% on Monday, leaving them under pressure as lenders reassessed their exposure to large AI infrastructure projects. According to Bloomberg’s November 16 report , citing people familiar with the transaction, HSBC sold its portion of the $18 billion financing package at prices in the mid-80s, meaning approximately 85 cents for each dollar of face value. The sale followed Oracle’s decision to issue a force majeure notice to the project’s developer, a unit of Blue Owl Capital. historyItems.originalTitle: Oklo roundup: Groves-1 plans, Centrus contract, Aurora concrete
historyItems.originalSummary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO) (“Oklo”), an advanced nuclear technology company, today announced it has signed multiple definitive, multi-year contracts with Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU) (“Centrus”), a uranium enrichment and nuclear fuel services provider, for high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU). Under the agreements, Oklo will make prepayments for future HALEU deliveries to support construction of new U.S. uranium enrichment capacity with Centrus. The agreements formalize the June 2026 letter of intent between Oklo and Centrus and include enough HALEU to support up to five Aurora powerhouses for multiple years, with fuel deliveries from Centrus’ American Centrifuge Plant in Pike County, Ohio, scheduled to begin in 2029.This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261112814189/en/Oklo's Aurora powerhouse (Image: Oklo)The HALEU purchase is supported by Meta’s prepayment for future Oklo power production and secures fuel for the first phase of Oklo’s planned 1.2 GW power campus in Ohio. Meta’s previously announced agreement with Oklo linked prepayment for power with advancement of project development. With the funding, Oklo is able to advance fuel procurement with Centrus for the planned Ohio campus, which includes multiple Oklo Aurora powerhouses; expand Ohio’s clean energy workforce; and generate new local and state tax revenues through investment in energy infrastructure.The fuel supply marks a major step toward scaling Oklo’s power business beyond its first reactor. Building on Oklo’s allocation of recovered Experimental Breeder Reactor II (EBR-II) fuel for its first Aurora powerhouse in Idaho, the Centrus agreements secure HALEU for the first phase of the Ohio power campus, future Aurora deployments, and later refueling of the Aurora-INL.These agreements and its prepayments will further propel Centrus’ proven centrifuge manufacturing process that recently completed and began shipping its first new centrifuge as part of its domestic uranium enrichment expansion. Centrus has further de-risked its buildout by assembling a complete, unobligated supply chain to serve both the commercial and national security markets. Centrus has now secured $5.4 billion in customer contracts and commitments to purchase LEU and HALEU from the new capacity.“Securing fuel is essential to scaling our power business beyond our first reactor in Idaho,” said Oklo CEO and co-founder Jacob DeWitte. “These agreements support our initial Ohio deployments and provide fuel for future Aurora powerhouses. historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk Wants to Merge Tesla and SpaceX. Their Businesses Already Overlap.
historyItems.originalSummary: Thank you for your patience while we verify access. Nearly a decade ago, Elon Musk gave Tesla’s design team an unusual assignment: Build a sports car that can fly. Mr. Musk brought in a small team of engineers from SpaceX, his rocket company, to lend a hand. Led by Bill Riley, SpaceX’s executive overseeing engineering on the rocket intended to land NASA astronauts on the moon, the team juggled their day jobs with outfitting a Roadster sports car with cold-gas thrusters, a technology more commonly found in rockets that has enough force to burst a human eardrum, according to three people familiar with the project. This year, as engineers from both companies prepared for the car’s debut, they spent months putting it through its paces at SpaceX’s rocket testing facility in McGregor, Texas, the people said. In October, a driverless Roadster did a kick flip in midair, launching off a ramp more than 60 feet high. This is “what happens when you have a collaboration with the world’s best car company and the world’s best rocket company” Mr. Musk told the crowd.

historyItems.originalTitle: Nebius Lowers Outlook, Addresses Worries Over Financing AI Buildout
historyItems.originalSummary: By Kelly Cloonan Nebius Group lowered its full-year revenue outlook, citing a delay in some third-party capacity. The artificial-intelligence cloud company also addressed recent concerns over financing its buildout, emphasizing its momentum with customer prepayments. Nebius said Thursday it now expects full-year revenue to come in at the low end of its prior guidance range of $3 billion to $3.4 billion. Analysts polled by FactSet are forecasting $3.35 billion. The updated guidance factors in a portion of this year's revenue moving into next year, with some third-party capacity Nebius had expected to come online this year now scheduled for the first half of 2027, the company said. The contracts behind that capacity remain in place, the company said. Nebius also gave an initial outlook for next year, guiding for revenue of $12 billion to $13 billion, compared with analyst projections of $12.09 billion. The company said the forecast reflects a conservative approach to the pace of its buildout, and that it continues to expect to bring online more than 1 gigawatt of new capacity each year. "Our focus remains on building a healthy, profitable business for the long term," Chief Executive Arkady Volozh said in a letter to shareholders. The guidance comes amid investor worries over how neocloud companies will finance their growing footprints. CoreWeave, whose borrowing costs have surged in recent weeks and helped spark the market jitters, eased some of those concerns earlier this week after reporting better-than-expected quarterly revenue. Volozh said Nebius is able to finance its buildout in a prudent way through customer prepayments and a healthy balance sheet, helped by a strategy that lets it command premium prices and terms, and bring down its costs of infrastructure from designing and building it itself. Nebius expects prepayments and financing against existing contracts with investment-grade customers to cover 75% to 85% of its capital expenditures in 2027, and has a wide range of other funding options available, Volozh said. "Our confidence in the fundamentals of what we are building has not changed, and the opportunity ahead of us is as large as it has ever been. We will keep going," Volozh said. Nebius shares slid 12% to $136.66 in premarket trading. Nebius reported a third-quarter loss of $37.5 million, or 13 cents a share, compared with a loss of $119.6 million, or 50 cents a share, a year earlier. Revenue surged by more than six-fold to $980.8 million, compared with analyst estimates of $907.2 million. Write to Kelly Cloonan at kelly.cloonan@wsj.com (END) Dow Jones Newswires 11-12-26 0838ET

historyItems.summary: 資料基礎設施半導體解決方案領域的領導者 Marvell Technology, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）與 AI 工廠平台公司 Penguin Solutions, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：PENG）今天宣布開展策略合作，以滿足 AI 記憶體需求。此次合作匯集了兩項互補技術：基於 CXL 的記憶體擴展，使資料中心能夠使用現有 DDR4 記憶體擴展伺服器記憶體容量，以及先進的光子技術，旨在實現跨多個機架的高頻寬、低延遲記憶體共享。隨著 AI 工作負載從模型訓練轉向大規模推理和代理 AI，記憶體容量、頻寬和延遲正成為應用程式效能和代幣經濟性的關鍵限制因素。
historyItems.originalTitle: Marvell and Penguin Solutions Collaborate to Address Data Center AI Memory and Accelerate Inference at Scale
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), a leader in data infrastructure semiconductor solutions and Penguin Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: PENG), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced a strategic collaboration to address AI memory demands. This collaboration brings together two complementary technologies: CXL-based memory expansion that enables data centers to extend server memory capacity using existing DDR4 memory, and advanced photonic technology designed to enable high-bandwidth, low latency memory sharing across multiple racks.As AI workloads shift from model training to large-scale inference and agentic AI, memory capacity, bandwidth, and latency are becoming critical constraints on application performance and token economics. Growing model sizes, longer context windows, and expanding KV-cache requirements are driving memory needs into hundreds of gigabytes and increasingly terabytes per node. These demands are accelerating the shift beyond traditional server-attached memory toward memory expansion, pooling, and disaggregation technologies such as CXL and optical shared-memory fabrics, enabling memory capacity to scale independently of compute.Two Complementary Levels of Memory ExpansionMarvell and Penguin Solutions are developing two complementary memory expansion technologies designed to address AI infrastructure needs at the server and pod levels:Direct-attach memory expansion: The planned addition of Marvell® Structera™ X memory-expansion controllers within Penguin Solutions SMART® CXL AICs enables data centers to unlock additional memory capacity by recycling existing high-density DDR4 memory modules from decommissioned servers and connecting them directly to servers through PCIe 5.0 and CXL 2.0. This approach provides scalable, low-latency memory expansion in a standard form factor designed for broader industry adoption.Multi-rack photonic memory pooling: By integrating Marvell® Photonic Fabric™ optical interconnect technology-based memory modules and NICs into Penguin Solutions MemoryAI™ memory appliances and ComputeAI™ systems, AI data centers will be able to support low-latency, high-bandwidth, multi-rack disaggregated memory sharing across longer distances, enabling petabyte-scale memory pools for context-rich agentic AI inference.These two technologies are highly complementary. Direct-attach memory expansion addresses immediate, server-level capacity needs today, while multi-rack photonic memory sharing is designed to enable high-bandwidth, low-latency memory sharing across multiple racks to support increasingly demanding AI workloads. Together, these approaches are designed to provide customers with greater flexibility to expand memory capacity and scale AI infrastructure as its needs evolve, offering a single upgrade path from direct-attach expansion to disaggregated, multi-rack sharing, without re-architecting their infrastructure at each step.An additional benefit of the standard AIC form factor is its ability to support memory expansion beyond direct server attachment. historyItems.originalTitle: TSLA, SPCX Diverge Overnight As Retail Traders Split On Merger Winner — Could SpaceX Get Tesla’s S&P 500 Seat?
historyItems.originalSummary: A merger could give SpaceX a route into the S&P 500 if the combined company keeps Tesla's seat. Barclays sees an all-stock deal as the likeliest outcome, with SpaceX buying Tesla and Tesla holders receiving SpaceX shares. Musk said independent directors are handling the talks and holders of 50% of all outstanding Tesla shares would need to vote in favor.

historyItems.title: SK 海力士計畫設立晶片測試中心以推動韓國小型企業的發展
historyItems.summary: SK 海力士計畫與韓國政府合作於 2027 年開設半導體測試設施，旨在提高該國小型晶片設備製造商的全球競爭力。 SK 海力士週一（11 月 16 日）在一份聲明中表示，這座耗資 8,746 億韓元（6.54 億美元）的設施正在首爾以南龐大的龍仁半導體集群內建造。 Trinity Fab 工廠將於 5 月開業，配備的設備可供中小型供應商在其產品部署到商業晶片生產線之前進行最終性能和產量驗證。
historyItems.originalTitle: SK Hynix Plans Chip Testing Hub to Boost Smaller Korean Players
historyItems.originalSummary: SK HYNIX plans to open a semiconductor testing facility in 2027 in partnership with the South Korean government, angling to boost the global competitiveness of the country’s smaller chip equipment makers. The 874.6 billion won (US$654 million) facility is being built inside the sprawling Yongin Semiconductor Cluster, which is under construction south of Seoul, SK Hynix said in a statement on Monday (Nov 16). The Trinity Fab facility will open in May with equipment that small and medium-sized suppliers can use to conduct final performance and yield validation before their products are deployed in commercial chipmaking lines, it said.

historyItems.summary: 聯合發射聯盟火神號配備了六個固體火箭助推器，從卡納維拉爾角的 41 號發射台升空。飛行 10 分鐘後發生故障，導致 40 顆亞馬遜獅子座衛星遺失。圖片來源：Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now 聯合發射聯盟遭遇重大挫折，該公司搭載一批亞馬遜 Leo 網路衛星的新型重型火神火箭在周日爬升太空過程中發生故障，導致有效載荷失效，並給兩家公司的發射計劃造成了代價高昂的影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: ULA suffers first outright failure with loss of Vulcan rocket carrying 40 Amazon Leo satellites
historyItems.originalSummary: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan, equipped with six solid rocket boosters, lifts off from Cape Canaveral's pad 41. A failure 10 minutes into flight resulted in the loss of 40 Amazon Leo satellites. Image: Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now In a major setback for United Launch Alliance, the company’s new heavy-lift Vulcan rocket carrying a batch of Amazon Leo internet satellites, malfunctioned during the climb to space Sunday, dooming the payload and throwing a costly wrench into the launch schedule of both companies. “Based on data received by our Launch Director, we confirm that the Vulcan vehicle launched from Space Launch Complex 41 (at the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station) suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit,” ULA said in a statement some 50 minutes after liftoff. “We will work closely with our customer and other appropriate organizations to find the cause, determine the appropriate corrective action and return to flight as quickly as possible.” It was the first outright failure of a United Launch Alliance rocket since the company, a partnership between Boeing and Lockheed Martin, was formed in 2006. It wasn’t immediately known what went wrong, but the Vulcan, the rocket replacing ULA’s fleet of Atlas 5 rockets, will face a potentially significant grounding while engineers review telemetry and implement fixes for whatever caused the mishap. It was only the fifth flight of a Vulcan rocket and the first in nine months as ULA and booster-supplier Northrop Grumman worked to resolve problems with nozzles used by strap-on solid-fuel boosters that marred two earlier flights. The solids appeared to work normally Sunday, helping boost the rocket out of the dense lower atmosphere before burning out and falling away. The two methane-burning BE-4 engines powering the Vulcan’s first stage then continued the climb toward orbit, but they appeared to fire longer than expected based on ULA’s pre-launch timeline. After stage separation, the Vulcan’s hydrogen-fueled Centaur upper stage engines took over for a planned 12-minute 15-second burn. According to ULA’s update, something went wrong during that Centaur firing, but no additional details were immediately provided. Sunday’s launch was the first of 38 Vulcan flights purchased by Amazon to launch its Leo satellites, designed to compete head-to-head with Elon Musk’s Starlinks and other space-based internet providers. ULA already has launched eight LEO flights using Atlas 5 rockets.

historyItems.originalTitle: Firefly Aerospace Inks $1.3 Billion Deal With AST SpaceMobile for Rocket Engines
historyItems.originalSummary: Firefly Aerospace has signed an agreement valued at more than $1.3 billion with AST SpaceMobile to supply rocket engines, license engine intellectual property, and provide engineering support for AST SpaceMobile’s new heavy-lift launch vehicle. The three-year agreement includes the delivery of 36 rocket engines and provides AST SpaceMobile with rights to manufacture engines using Firefly’s technology. The transaction represents a substantial commercial agreement for Firefly and supports AST SpaceMobile’s strategy of developing its own launch infrastructure for satellite deployments. Under the agreement, Firefly will provide 27 Miranda engines and nine Vira vacuum engines for AST SpaceMobile’s first three rockets. The engines will support development of a new heavy-lift launch vehicle intended to deploy AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird satellites into low Earth orbit. AST SpaceMobile is developing a space-based cellular broadband network designed to provide connectivity directly to standard mobile devices. The company requires substantial launch capacity to deploy its satellite constellation and expand network coverage. Developing its own launch vehicle could provide greater control over launch schedules and reduce dependence on third-party rocket availability. Firefly will supply the propulsion technology while maintaining ownership of its underlying intellectual property. AST SpaceMobile will receive a license allowing it to manufacture the engines for its launch program.

historyItems.summary: SpaceX 使用連接在發射塔上的巨型機械手臂成功抓住了火箭的上級，從而在其星際飛船計劃中實現了一個重要的里程碑。太空船在太空停留22.5小時後返回地球，這是首次透過該技術成功回收太空船。然而，這次任務只取得了部分成功，因為火箭的下部未能實現計畫中的回收嘗試。 Starship 完成 22.5 小時的飛行 當地時間週五 16 點 47 分，124 公尺高的 Starship 火箭從 SpaceX 位於德克薩斯州博卡奇卡的 Starbase 發射設施升空。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX catches upper stage of Starship rocket in historic first
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX has achieved a major milestone in its Starship programme by successfully catching the rocket's upper stage using giant mechanical arms attached to its launch tower. The spacecraft returned to Earth after spending 22.5 hours in space, marking the first successful recovery of the Ship through this technique. However, the mission was only partially successful, as the rocket's lower section failed its planned recovery attempt. Starship completes 22.5-hour flight The 124-metre-tall Starship rocket lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase launch facility in Boca Chica, Texas, at 16:47 local time on Friday. This was the 15th test flight of the spacecraft and the first attempt to recover both sections of the rocket during the same mission. After reaching space, the upper stage, known as the Ship, deployed 26 satellites for SpaceX's Starlink internet constellation. It subsequently completed 14 orbits around Earth before beginning its return journey. The moment a Starship booster exploded during an attempted landing at SpaceX’s facility today. https://t.co/HoRscWHVH0 — распад и неуважение (@VictorKvert2008) November 14, 2026 &nbsp; How did SpaceX catch Starship? As the Ship approached its launch site, it hovered near the launch tower, where two enormous mechanical arms, nicknamed 'chopsticks', moved into position and secured the returning spacecraft. The arms are part of SpaceX's Mechazilla recovery system, which is designed to catch returning rocket stages instead of allowing them to land on the ground using conventional landing legs. This was the first time SpaceX successfully caught Starship's upper stage. The company had previously demonstrated the technique with its Super Heavy booster, which it had caught on three earlier test flights. What happened to Starship's booster? While the upper-stage recovery succeeded, the mission encountered a problem during the attempted recovery of the Super Heavy booster. The lower section was expected to return to the launch tower approximately six and a half minutes after liftoff. However, an automated abort system cancelled the catch attempt and diverted the booster towards the ocean. The booster hovered above the water before bursting into flames. Elon Musk later said on X that it was "slightly low on fuel". Why does SpaceX want to recover both stages? SpaceX aims to make Starship completely reusable to reduce the cost of launching payloads into space. Recovering both sections would allow the company to inspect, refuel and prepare the rocket for subsequent flights. The approach builds on the company's Falcon 9 programme, whose reusable boosters have helped reduce launch costs. Why is this important for NASA's Moon mission? Starship's development is closely linked to NASA's Artemis programme. SpaceX has a contract to develop a lunar lander based on Starship that could transport astronauts to the Moon's surface. However, the company must demonstrate reliable recovery and repeated operations before Starship can fulfil its ambitious role in future lunar missions.

historyItems.originalSummary: Baron Capital , an investment management company, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for its "Baron Global Opportunity Fund". The letter can be downloaded here . The fund gained 3.3% (Institutional Shares) in the quarter, outperforming the 1.6% gain for the MSCI ACWI Index (the Index) and the 0.5% decline for the MSCI ACWI Growth Index, the Fund's benchmarks. YTD, the Fund is up 24.6% vs. 13.0% and 10.1% gains for the benchmarks, respectively. Strong stock selection and sector allocation drove 172 bps of outperformance in the quarter. Information Technology and Health Care led sector returns, while Developed Markets led regional gains. The Fund remains optimistic about the potential of AI and the Space Economy despite geopolitical uncertainties and rising interest rates. Guided by its long-term strategy, the Fund remains optimistic about its portfolio's prospects and is patiently seeking new opportunities that trade at attractive discounts to intrinsic value. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Fluence Energy, Inc. (FLNC) latest stock news and headlines
historyItems.originalSummary: The lawsuit alleges Fluence Energy's fiscal 2026 guidance rested on contract manufacturing facilities that were not ready to produce at assumed volumes. Three heavy-volume selloffs followed as that alleged gap surfaced, and this release measures the market impact of each. NEW YORK , Nov. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SueWallSt alerts investors in Fluence Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNC ) of a pending securities class action on behalf of purchasers of Fluence Energy securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026. Find out if you may qualify to recover losses or contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. at [email protected] or (888) SueWallSt. FLNC closed at $28.99 on February 4, 2026, and faltered to just $18.95 the following day, a decline of $10.04 per share, or about 34.63%. The complaint highlights two further declines of about $1.02, or 7.17% on August 6, 2026 and of $1.39, or about 15.36% on September 17, 2026. To be considered for lead plaintiff, investors must file by November 27, 2026. The Market Impact of Each FLNC Disclosure Day As averred, the decline unfolded in stages because Fluence Energy reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 outlook alongside the February 4, 2026 results and again on May 6, 2026. The pleading asserts that the Company did not disclose that delivering backlog and recognizing guided revenue depended on new contract manufacturing facilities that were not completed, not operational, or not capable of the assumed volumes. It further asserts that corrective measures at the Company's contract manufacturers were not remediating the production problems. The complaint charges that the August 5, 2026 report, which blamed weaker revenue on "production delays at new contract manufacturing facilities," and the September 16, 2026 update, which cited "continuing supply chain issues affecting the Company's U.S. production," each partially corrected those alleged misstatements. "Fluence Energy shareholders absorbed three heavy-volume selloffs in under eight months, and the complaint alleges each one followed news about contract manufacturing problems that had not been disclosed when guidance was set. On the night of November 13, 2026, Meta Platforms ( NASDAQ:META ) employees were asked to predict who would win the quiz show Jeopardy! inside an unreleased app called Takes. historyItems.title: 泰瑞達受益於強勁的測試需求：它能否擊敗 KLAC 和 COHU？
historyItems.summary: Teradyne TER 受益於強勁的半導體測試需求、加速的人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資以及先進晶片架構日益複雜的情況。對人工智慧加速器、高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 和高效能運算解決方案的需求不斷增長，增強了該公司的成長前景以及相對於 KLA KLAC 和 Cohu COHU 的競爭地位。泰瑞達公佈了令人印象深刻的 2026 年第三季業績，營收年增 70% 至 13.1 億美元。在人工智慧加速器、高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 和電源管理解決方案的強勁需求的支援下，半導體測試收入成長了 77%，達到超過 10 億美元。
historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne Benefits From Strong Test Demand: Can It Beat KLAC & COHU?
historyItems.originalSummary: Teradyne TER is benefiting from strong semiconductor test demand, accelerating artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, and increasing complexity in advanced chip architectures. Rising demand for AI accelerators, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and high-performance computing solutions is strengthening the company's growth prospects and competitive position against KLA KLAC and Cohu COHU. Teradyne reported impressive third-quarter 2026 results, with revenues surging 70% year over year to $1.31 billion. Semiconductor Test revenues increased 77% to more than $1 billion, supported by robust demand for AI accelerators, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and power management solutions. Compute revenues grew nearly 50%, while memory revenues reached a record $301 million, reflecting strong demand for HBM and DRAM testing. Teradyne's expanding product portfolio is another key growth driver. The company's UltraFLEXplus platform is gaining traction as hyperscalers increasingly adopt dual-vendor testing strategies. Its recently introduced UltraVS64-HP, UltraPort-PCIe6 and Magnum E2 solutions strengthen its ability to address next-generation AI accelerators, high-speed connectivity and advanced memory testing requirements. Teradyne expects additional hyperscaler capacity purchases and compute-related revenue opportunities in 2027. Teradyne's expanding AI-driven opportunities and product innovations position it favorably to sustain momentum against KLAC and COHU. For the fourth quarter of 2026, Teradyne expects revenues between $1.25 billion and $1.35 billion. The midpoint of the guidance range stands at $1.30 billion.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX’s Starship Launch Today Could Lift the Stock
historyItems.originalSummary: If you find yourself in Texas during the next flight of SpaceX's massive Starship rocket , you may be in for quite a show. Anytime the world's largest rocket is due to get off the ground at SpaceX's Starbase headquarters in Boca Chica, a crowd is sure to form at the nearby South Padre Island . This time, though, it may not be just the launch of Starship that attracts spectators, but the possible return a day later of the rocket's upper section to South Texas. Up until now, SpaceX has sought to land the upper stage vehicle in distant oceans after it hits its objectives and completes its test flights. In some infamous cases, the vehicle has even accidentally exploded in the air mid-flight. For the first time, though, the plan is for both Starship's stages to travel back to Starbase after doing their jobs. And in the case of the upper stage, that dramatic landmark homecoming should take it over a large swath of Texas . Here's where you can watch SpaceX conduct its next Starship flight test from Starbase, Texas, as well as what to expect for a mission referred to as flight 15 . SpaceX, which tech mogul Elon Musk founded in 2002, is developing Starship to be a fully reusable transportation system, meaning both the rocket and vehicle can return to the ground for additional missions. Reaching 407 feet tall when fully stacked, Starship is regarded as the largest and most powerful launch vehicle ever developed. The rocket is composed of both the 236-foot lower stage booster known as Super Heavy that provides the initial burst of thrust at liftoff, and a 171-foot upper stage that flies in orbit. The third and latest prototype of Starship, known as Version 3 (V3) is still undergoing test flights as SpaceX races to have it ready for NASA's Artemis lunar landings and Musk's own dreams of crewed trips to Mars . Starship is also central to SpaceX's plans of expanding its Starlink satellite internet business. SpaceX is working toward a Friday, Nov. 13, launch of its Starship rocket, the company announced . The launch window is due to open from 4:45 to 6 p.m. CT. This time, though, spectators in Texas may want to make a point to not just catch the launch, but the return of the section of the rocket that flies in space nearly a day later (see more on that below).

historyItems.originalTitle: Nokia Federal Solutions awarded Department of War RAPID contract to advance multi-domain threat awareness
historyItems.originalSummary: CHANTILLY, Va., 13 November 2026 | 14:00 PM Europe/Amsterdam Nokia Federal Solutions awarded Department of War RAPID contract to advance multi-domain threat awareness Press Release Nokia Federal Solutions today announced that it has been awarded a contract under the Department of War's (DoW) RAPID project, managed by the FutureG Office within the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering (OUSW(R&E)). The award supports Real-World Application Prototyping for ISAC Demonstration (RAPID), leveraging 5G and 6G infrastructure for object detection and tracking. Under the contract, Nokia Federal will develop, build and test integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) capabilities and demonstrate an end-to-end solution for the DoW's RAPID project. The effort supports the FutureG Office's mission by demonstrating how 5G and future 6G networks can be leveraged to improve threat detection and situational awareness, helping protect critical infrastructure against emerging threats. Built on Nokia's AI-RAN platform, the project will integrate Nokia and third-party applications for sensing and spectrum threat awareness. It will combine multiple sensing modalities and sensor fusion to help provide a more comprehensive picture of potential unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) threats. Subcontractors supporting the effort include Nokia affiliates, Texas Tech University, DeepSig, Hidden Level and Future Technologies. " The unmanned system threat is real. Integrated sensing and communications provides the opportunity to help protect critical infrastructure by leveraging the existing cellular networks to identify the threat. This project in partnership with Department of War is helping to advance the technology and the ecosystem to make that a reality. Steve Vogelsang, Chief Technology Officer, Nokia Federal Solutions " " In the FutureG Office, we are accelerating and adapting commercial wireless technologies to meet the requirements of the Department of War, and ISAC is at the forefront of this effort. Through RAPID and related initiatives, we are cultivating an open ecosystem that enables us to leverage commercial cellular infrastructure to bolster force protection and defense of critical assets against evolving UAV threats. Marlan Macklin, Deputy Principal Director for FutureG in OUSW(R&E) " The award reinforces Nokia Federal's role in supporting the DoW FutureG Office's mission by bringing proven commercial innovation into mission-critical environments. It also highlights how commercial technologies can be applied to meet the DoW's most demanding operational requirements. historyItems.originalTitle: ULA delays to Sunday Vulcan rocket launch of 40 Leo satellites for Amazon
historyItems.originalSummary: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan, equipped with six solid rocket boosters, stands ready for launch at Cape Canaveral's pad 41. The rocket will carry 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit. Image: Michael Cain/Spaceflight Now. Update: Launch has now slipped to Sunday at 12:11 p.m. EST (1711 UTC) due to a network communication issue between the ground and the rocket that could not be resolved in time for Saturday’s launch window. United Launch Alliance will try again Saturday to launch its Vulcan rocket after a power interruption at a nitrogen plant scrubbed Friday’s attempt, further postponing the 215-foot-tall vehicle’s return to flight after solid rocket booster nozzles failed on two of its first four missions. Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 41 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is now scheduled for 12:32:30 p.m. EST (1732:30 UTC) Saturday, Nov. 14. ULA said the rocket and the 40 Amazon Leo satellites it carries remain healthy. “The launch of a United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket carrying the Amazon [LV-01] mission is delayed due to a power interruption in the Air Liquide gaseous nitrogen plant which resulted in the loss of their high-pressure pumps,” ULA said in a statement Friday morning. “Without confirmation of sustained commodity flow, the team has decided to realign the launch to the back-up opportunity.” Spaceflight Now will have live coverage Saturday beginning 30 minutes prior to liftoff. ULA announced the delay at 8:41 a.m. EST, a little more than four hours before the originally scheduled Friday liftoff and after the launch team had begun loading liquid oxygen into the rocket’s Centaur 5 upper stage, according to the company’s live mission updates. Gaseous nitrogen is used to purge and pressurize systems on the rocket and launchpad. The one-day delay extends a nine-month wait since the most recent solid rocket booster malfunction prompted the U.S. government to pause its use of the non-reusable rocket for national security missions. The now-delayed mission serves a private customer, Amazon, which has tasked ULA with ferrying 40 broadband internet satellites to expand its Leo constellation. It’s the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has purchased. ULA has not said how long Saturday’s launch window will last. The rocket will fly on a northeasterly trajectory upon leaving the pad.

historyItems.summary: 今天晚些時候，SpaceX 正計劃對其大型新型火箭星際飛船進行迄今為止最雄心勃勃的測試。如果一切順利，它將從德克薩斯州南部的一個發射場升空，繞著地球飛行一周，然後在 22 個半小時後垂直降落在同一個發射場。這項測試將成為火箭的一個重要里程碑，公司創辦人馬斯克表示，他希望有一天能將太空人送上火星。但專家表示，Starship 的快速發展最終也可能讓該公司多年來最大的支持者之一——美國太空總署 (NASA) 陷入困境。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX's giant rocket may leave NASA in the dust
historyItems.originalSummary: Later today, SpaceX is planning the most ambitious test yet of its massive new rocket Starship. If all goes well, it will lift off from a pad in South Texas, circle the Earth and then land vertically at the same pad 22 and a half hours later. The test would be a major milestone for a rocket that company founder Elon Musk says he hopes will one day carry astronauts to Mars. But experts say the rapid development of Starship could also end up stranding one of the company's biggest boosters over the years: NASA. That's because as SpaceX ramps up its new rocket, it has said it will stop flying a much smaller one called Falcon 9. Falcon 9 launches the company's Dragon capsule, which is currently the only American spacecraft capable of ferrying NASA astronauts to and from the International Space Station. "Because Dragon has become such a successful and reliable vehicle, it became the de facto way for astronauts to get to orbit," said Caleb Henry, director of research at Quilty Space, a firm that tracks the space industry. According to a NASA announcement in September, the space agency has contracted with SpaceX for three additional flights to the International Space Station. That would only allow Dragon to fly through 2028, assuming the missions were flown consecutively in six month increments and no further flights are contracted with SpaceX.

historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile presses case for developing own launch vehicle
historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in AST SpaceMobile, Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better. AST SpaceMobile plans to build Blacklift , a reusable rocket designed to carry up to five BlueBird satellites, with a first launch targeted for late 2028 and capacity for as many as two launches per month. The company expects to keep using providers such as SpaceX and Blue Origin for about two more years. Developing Blacklift will require several hundred million dollars in additional capital spending next year , but the company says owning launch capability could eventually cut launch costs by 75% and improve schedule certainty. AST says it is producing six satellites per month and expects 25 satellites to enable initial beta service in the U.S. and several other markets. It also reports agreements with about 60 mobile operators covering roughly 3 billion devices.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX plans over $74 billion investment in Texas, Arizona AI campuses
historyItems.originalSummary: SpaceX (SPCX) pegs its Texas and Arizona AI campuses at over $74 billion, yet the shares barely moved because most of it is planned spending. Arizona is the riskier, larger half: a roughly $50 billion campus filed through shell company Tombstone Resources, with no contract backing promised jobs or bill cuts. A December 9 Cochise County zoning hearing decides whether the $74 billion plan holds or the Arizona half falls into doubt. On November 12, 2026, SpaceX ( NASDAQ:SPCX ) put a single price on its AI expansion. In a company update, it said a supercompute facility at Starbase in Texas' Rio Grande Valley and a campus in Cochise County, Arizona, together represent more than $74 billion in planned American investment.

historyItems.title: 建造火箭很難。 AST SpaceMobile 認為這很「簡單」。
historyItems.summary: 在周四長達一小時的活動中，電信公司 AST SpaceMobile 的創始人兼執行長 Abel Avellan 闡述了他開發大型火箭以將藍鳥衛星送入軌道的願景。阿維蘭一再強調，AST 計劃建造一枚「簡單」火箭。他多次引用 SpaceX 創始人埃隆馬斯克的話說：「最好的部分就是沒有部分。」阿維蘭強調，AST 已經為其擬議的 Blacklift 火箭採購了發動機，並聲稱發動機開發佔典型火箭開發週期的 80%。 「當然，火箭工程師會對我生氣，但你可以將其簡化為一個大型油箱供給發動機，」他談到火箭時說道。
historyItems.originalTitle: Building a rocket is hard. AST SpaceMobile thinks it’s “simple.”
historyItems.originalSummary: During an hour-long event on Thursday, Abel Avellan, the founder and chief executive of the telecommunications company AST SpaceMobile, laid out his vision for developing a large rocket to launch his Bluebird satellites into orbit. Avellan emphasized, over and over again, that AST plans to build a “simple” rocket. He paraphrased SpaceX founder Elon Musk several times, saying, “the best part is no part.” Avellan emphasized that AST has already procured engines for its proposed Blacklift rocket, asserting that engine development accounts for 80 percent of a typical rocket’s development cycle. “Of course rocket engineers are going to get mad with me, but you can simplify it as a big tank feeding engines,” he said of the rocket. “So big tanks—we know how to do them. We know how to do them. We know how to do them in composite.” I am not a rocket engineer, and I am not mad at Avellan. But he sure seems to be substantially underestimating the challenge of building rockets. Avellan also has a problem. AST SpaceMobile appears to be successful in building very large satellites, Bluebirds, that are capable of providing direct-to-cell capability from an orbit about 550km above Earth. The problem is there is a commercial launch crunch, and the company is struggling to get its satellites on orbit today, and projects to do so into the future. “We’re not doing this thing because we like rockets,” he said during the presentation. “We’re not doing this thing because we want to be in the launch business. We want this because we have so much demand of our satellites, and as you have seen it, we cannot get enough launches.” The Blacklift rocket will be “simple,” he said, because it will be solely tailored to lift five Bluebird satellites into low-Earth orbit at a time. It will have 20 metric tons of lift capacity, a reusable first stage, and launch twice a month from a pad at Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia that formerly served the Antares rocket. It will have all composite tanks and three stages. And, Avellan said, it will be ready to launch in 2028. If that timeline sounds preposterous, that’s because it is. However, Avellan believes AST has a workaround: It is committed to spending $1.3 billion to acquire enough engines for the first three Blacklift launches from Firefly Aerospace, as well as a license to manufacture additional engines over time. He is basing this argument on the Miranda first stage engine, which he said is “ready to fly.” But that’s not quite true. However, Miranda has not yet completed its formal qualification campaign, much less flown on an orbital rocket. Firefly chief executive Jason Kim said this week that qualification testing remains underway. Moreover, little is known publicly about the readiness of the upper stage engine, Vira, that AST is also acquiring from Firefly for its rocket.

historyItems.summary: Ondas 自主系統技術長兼總工程師 Judith Hocherman-Frommer 博士在特拉維夫博覽會舉行的 UVID DroneTech 2026 會議上宣布，Ondas 已在以色列投資 10 億美元。她表示：「對以色列的投資正變得至關重要。」她補充說，這家美國公司在過去 18 個月內收購了 27 家國防科技公司，其中大多數是以色列公司。
historyItems.originalTitle: Ondas bets big on Israel with $1b. investment over past year
historyItems.originalSummary: Ondas has invested $1 billion in Israel, Dr. Judith Hocherman-Frommer, CTO and chief engineer of Ondas Autonomous Systems, announced at the UVID DroneTech 2026 conference at Expo Tel Aviv. “Investment in Israel is becoming mission critical,” she said, adding that the US-based company has acquired 27 defense-tech companies over the past 18 months, the majority being Israeli companies. The others are from the United States or Europe."We do not only acquire companies; we invest in each one to maximize its capabilities and create opportunities for collaboration among them to solve operational challenges in real time,” she added.The acquisitions are part of Ondas' broader push to build a vertically integrated defense technology company spanning the development, manufacturing, and deployment of autonomous systems. Its portfolio includes autonomous drones, counter-UAS systems, robotic ground platforms, unmanned aircraft, and systems for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions.The company's motto, she said, is “Bots before boots,” with autonomous systems leading and clearing the way ahead of the warfighter.According to Hocherman-Frommer, threats are evolving at a pace not seen before, within months rather than years, and therefore require fast, practical responses as well as strong integration between Israel's operational innovation and global manufacturing and deployment infrastructures.The modern battlefield is creating “a democratization of low-cost threats at massive scale, asymmetric warfare, and a constant learning race that demands flexibility and rapid adaptation. At the same time, these realities are colliding with multi-year development cycles and legacy architectures on the ground."In response, the defense industry needs to change its operating model, as “the response to rapidly evolving threats can no longer rely on development programs that take years to complete, nor on expensive, standalone missiles designed to counter swarms of low-cost drones."Instead, "There must be a shift toward developing simpler and faster systems, manufacturing large quantities at high quality and affordable cost, and advancing toward autonomy, where systems operate independently while human operators provide high-level oversight."“Speed is the new strategic advantage,” she stressed.Digital BatHocherman-Frommer's comments came just days after Ondas announced that it had received a purchase order under its Digital Bat program, a next-generation tactical attack drone designed to meet what the company believes could become demand for tens of thousands of affordable autonomous strike systems. The company said the order marks a transition from development toward serial production and large-scale manufacturing. Ondas said it plans to leverage its pending acquisition of ARAN Defense, an Israeli engineering and manufacturing company, to establish dedicated production lines capable of manufacturing thousands of systems. The acquisition is expected to add engineering, industrialization, systems integration, supply-chain management, and manufacturing capabilities to Ondas' growing defense portfolio.The Digital Bat program is expected to be led by Airobotic

historyItems.originalSummary: Baron Capital , an investment management company, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for its "Baron Global Opportunity Fund". The letter can be downloaded here . The fund gained 3.3% (Institutional Shares) in the quarter, outperforming the 1.6% gain for the MSCI ACWI Index (the Index) and the 0.5% decline for the MSCI ACWI Growth Index, the Fund's benchmarks. YTD, the Fund is up 24.6% vs. 13.0% and 10.1% gains for the benchmarks, respectively. Strong stock selection and sector allocation drove 172 bps of outperformance in the quarter. Information Technology and Health Care led sector returns, while Developed Markets led regional gains. The Fund remains optimistic about the potential of AI and the Space Economy despite geopolitical uncertainties and rising interest rates. Guided by its long-term strategy, the Fund remains optimistic about its portfolio's prospects and is patiently seeking new opportunities that trade at attractive discounts to intrinsic value. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: TSMC Approves Up to $1 Billion Investment Plan in Anthropic, OpenAI
historyItems.originalSummary: Android Headlines / Tech News / TSMC Backs Anthropic and OpenAI With $1 Billion Investment TSMC’s board has approved an investment plan of up to $1 billion in two AI companies, OpenAI and Anthropic. It plans to invest $500 million in Anthropic IPO and another $500 million in OpenAI’s preferred stock. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) has approved an investment of $1 billion in two AI companies, OpenAI and Anthropic. The world’s largest contract chipmaker plans to invest $500 million in each company. It looks forward to expanding financial ties with two well-known names in the AI industry, especially as AI demand grows. In a recent development, TSMC’s board has approved a $500 million investment in Anthropic’s upcoming Initial Public Offering (IPO). Moreover, the top management has also cleared an investment of up to $500 million in OpenAI preferred stock. With this financial step, the company seeks a stake in both AI companies. Anthropic has priced its IPO at between $70 and $78 per share. The tech giant is targeting a total valuation of up to $1.4 trillion. On the other hand, the Claude developer is raising another $26 billion through a separate private placement. Multiple companies worldwide are backing the funding. The list includes Alphabet’s Google, Nvidia, AMD, and Microsoft. TSMC’s investment timing is particularly noticeable because it comes amid surging demand for AI chips. It already plays an important role in the AI industry and with the following step, it wants to further strengthen its position. The company is a key supplier to Nvidia, whose graphics processors are widely used to train and run AI models. TSMC has been breaking records in terms of overall growth and revenue. For reference, it recently reported its sixth consecutive quarter of record profit last month and said demand for AI-related chips remained “extremely robust”. What’s even more surprising is that it expects its revenue to grow further by 44% in 2026. The Taiwanese company recently said that the demand is so strong that its current manufacturing capacity is falling short of fulfilling it. To address this, TSMC is investing $265 billion in manufacturing facilities in Arizona . It is also exploring projects in Texas. In a nutshell, the company is going all out on AI, whether in the form of expanding its manufacturing capacity or investing $1 billion in AI companies.

historyItems.originalSummary: Nov 10 (Reuters) - CoreWeave beat Wall Street estimates for quarterly revenue on Tuesday, driven by strong demand for its cloud services, easing recent concerns around the durability of AI infrastructure demand amid ‌its mounting debt load. The company's shares were up more than 7% in extended trading following a ‌sharp slump last month.

historyItems.summary: 新東岸園區將支援甲骨文在雲端、人工智慧和醫療保健領域的持續成長，並在田納西州奧斯汀、德克薩斯州和田納西州納許維爾創造數千個高品質就業機會。 2026 年 11 月 10 日 /美通社/ -- 甲骨文今天在納許維爾東岸舉行了未來全球總部的奠基儀式，推進了對該市作為雲、人工智慧和醫療保健技術不斷發展的中心的投資。憑藉在納許維爾的強大影響力，甲骨文繼續吸引本地和全國各地的工程和技術人才，並計劃隨著園區開發的進展創造數千個高品質就業機會。
historyItems.originalTitle: Oracle breaks ground on Nashville headquarters, pledges jobs and community investment
historyItems.originalSummary: New East Bank campus will support Oracle's continued growth in cloud, AI, and healthcare and create thousands of high-quality jobs in Tennessee AUSTIN, Texas and NASHVILLE, Tenn., Nov. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle today held its groundbreaking ceremony for its future global headquarters on Nashville's East Bank, advancing its investment in the city as a growing hub for cloud, AI, and healthcare technology. Building on its strong presence in Nashville, Oracle continues to attract engineering and technical talent locally and from across the country, with plans to create thousands of high-quality jobs as campus development progresses.

historyItems.originalSummary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after hotter-than-expected October inflation data sparked fresh concerns that persistent price pressures could prompt the Federal Reserve to deliver larger interest rate increases. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers climbed 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in October 2026. Meanwhile, core inflation, which measures all items excluding volatile food and energy costs, advanced 0.3 percent. The higher-than-anticipated figures dampened investor sentiment across Wall Street, as persistent price pressures suggest the central bank may need to keep borrowing costs elevated for longer than previously anticipated. Rising interest rates typically weigh on corporate valuations by increasing borrowing expenses and diminishing the present value of future earnings. As Treasury yields surged following the government data release, equities faced broad-based downward pressure, highlighting market sensitivity to persistent macroeconomic headwinds. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Among others, the following stocks were impacted: Innio’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 39 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business. Innio is down 58.6% since the beginning of the year, and at $13.77 per share, it is trading 66.5% below its 52-week high of $41.13 from June 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of Innio’s shares at the IPO in June 2026 would now be looking at an investment worth $413.51. ALSO WORTH WATCHING: Nvidia’s Quiet Partner. historyItems.originalTitle: Ge Vernova Inc Stock (GEV) Opened Down by 7.06% on Nov 10: Key Drivers Unveiled
historyItems.originalSummary: Ge Vernova Inc (GEV) opened down by 7.06%. The Utilities sector is down by 1.54%. The company underperformed the industry. Top 3 stocks by turnover in the sector: Ge Vernova Inc (GEV) down 7.06%; Nextera Energy Inc (NEE) down 0.71%; Eversource Energy (ES) down 0.75%. GE Vernova experienced pronounced downward pressure during the session, driven primarily by aggressive profit-taking and multiple compression across the power generation and electrical infrastructure sectors. After an extended period of outperformance fueled by the structural narrative surrounding artificial intelligence data center power demand and global grid modernization, elevated expectations have heightened sensitivity to any friction in project execution and capital expenditure cycles. A key catalyst behind the sell-off centers on renewed scrutiny over segment profitability, particularly surrounding the wind division. Persistent challenges in offshore wind project delivery, supply chain bottlenecks, and contract restructuring risks continue to act as an overhang on consolidated margins. While the company has made meaningful progress in de-risking its legacy offshore backlog, institutional investors remain cautious regarding the potential for further margin dilution or unexpected warranty charges before the segment achieves sustainable profitability. Simultaneously, broader industry dynamics within gas power and electrification equipment point to a pause in momentum. Despite robust order backlogs and favorable pricing power for heavy-duty gas turbines and grid solutions, market participants are increasingly focused on multi-year delivery timelines and the potential for utility customers to face regulatory or interconnection delays. Any indication of a moderated conversion pace from order book to revenue recognition leaves richly valued names susceptible to rapid valuation resets. Macroeconomic conditions and institutional positioning amplified the downward move. Upward pressure on benchmark yields and shifting expectations regarding federal energy policy and clean energy incentives prompted institutional desks to trim exposure to capital-intensive, high-valuation industrial names. Quantitative strategies and portfolio rebalancing away from momentum leadership into defensive value further accelerated intraday selling volume. Looking ahead, institutional focus will center on margin expansion trajectory within Electrification, cash flow conversion in the Power segment, and clear evidence of de-risking within Wind operations. While the long-term secular demand for power generation and transmission capacity remains intact, near-term price discovery will likely depend on management demonstrating sustained operating leverage and execution consistency across all business units. historyItems.originalTitle: Will it snow? Latest on potential nor’easter headed for Philly, NYC and DC
historyItems.originalSummary: An incoming storm is set to deliver the first snow of the season to parts of New England, though the Boston area will mainly contend with a cold, windswept rain starting Thursday. Several inches of wet snow are forecast for the highest elevations of Massachusetts and Northern New England. This system is set to eventually slide off the Mid-Atlantic coast late Thursday and develop into a nor’easter, bringing more rain, wind, and some wet snow through Friday. But unlike the other nor’easters we’ve seen this fall, we should avoid major impacts like coastal flooding. This one is more of an inconvenience for Greater Boston and Southern New England. • Snow — This storm holds a decent shot of delivering a coating to a couple of inches of snow along Route 2, west of I-495, and a coating to 3 inches of wet snow in a few higher-elevation spots across the Berkshires, northern Worcester County, and most of Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine, with isolated spots seeing 3 to 6 inches across the highest terrain. • Rain — For the lower elevations and by the coast, it just won’t be that cold for widespread snow. Greater Boston should end up with about a half inch of cold, windswept rain, a lot less than what we experienced last week . The same rain scenario plays out as you head south to Cape Cod, the South Coast, and Rhode Island.

historyItems.originalTitle: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
historyItems.originalSummary: A photo accompanying this announcement is available at https://www.globenewswire.com/NewsRoom/AttachmentNg/6bce8d6c-8a04-4d2e-bad7-c7d636371732 SAN DIEGO, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS), a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s initial Gateway ™ offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in subsequent years. The partnership aligns Kratos’ mission of being first to market and proven record of delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test and other vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges. The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.

historyItems.originalTitle: Cohu wins fourth customer for Eclipse handler in HPC chip testing
historyItems.originalSummary: SAN DIEGO, November 10, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )--Cohu, Inc. (NASDAQ: COHU), a global supplier of equipment and services optimizing semiconductor manufacturing yield and productivity, today announced that a new fabless semiconductor customer has selected Cohu's Eclipse platform for production testing of its next-generation high-performance computing (HPC) devices. The Eclipse ships with PAICe® Prescriptive software analytics tool that continuously analyzes equipment signals and behavior patterns to improve productivity. The devices will be tested at a high-volume manufacturing facility in Asia operated by a global outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) provider.

The equipment comes from Caterpillar orders that San Antonio-based OnePWR Solutions placed about two years ago but needed financing to complete. historyItems.summary: 人工智慧半導體巨頭英偉達 (Nvidia) 對其首席執行官黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 承認與涉嫌為中國政府從事間諜活動的女商人黃樂 (Alice Huang)（又名黃樂）有戀情，隨後對其展開獨立調查。這位科技大亨不僅是美國和人工智慧領域最有權勢的商界領袖之一，也是美國人工智慧領域最有影響力的商業領袖之一。他還與美國總統唐納德·川普保持著密切的關係，川普週日表示，黃是一個“值得尊敬的人”，應該繼續留任。這位將繼續領導該公司的高層——至少暫時是這樣——在美國時間週日之後向這家科技巨頭的員工發出了一條訊息。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy
historyItems.originalSummary: The artificial intelligence semiconductor giant Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, after he acknowledged a romantic relationship with businesswoman Alice Huang — also known as Huang Le — who is suspected of spying for the Chinese government. The tech mogul is not only one of the most powerful business leaders in the United States and the artificial intelligence sector; he also maintains a close relationship with U.S. President Donald Trump, who said Sunday that Huang is an “honorable guy” and should remain in his position. The executive, who will continue to lead the company — at least for the time being — sent a message to the tech giant’s employees on Sunday after U.S. media outlets published new details about the romantic relationship. In it, he admitted to being unfaithful to his wife. “I owe my family and all of you an apology... There is no excuse for what I did,” he wrote. “To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust.” The explosive situation began to come to light last month, when The New York Times broke the story about suspicions that Jensen Huang may have been the target of a Chinese espionage operation through his relationship with Huang Le. U.S. officials had concluded last year — as reported by the Times and later by other outlets — that Alice Huang, then a senior executive at Megaspeed International, had shared information with the Chinese government while collaborating with Nvidia, the world’s most valuable company, on the construction of data centers in Asia. U.S. investigators had launched their probe amid suspicions that Megaspeed helped Beijing gain access to advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors, the shipment of which to China is prohibited. The Singapore-based company had purchased enormous quantities of these chips from Nvidia: $4.8 billion worth over the past two years. Alice Huang was responsible for these purchasing operations at Megaspeed. Her biography indicates that she worked in China as a television journalist before becoming an executive at the Singapore-based company. According to the Times, last spring Secretary of State Marco Rubio oversaw the drafting of a classified memorandum detailing intelligence that showed Alice Huang had been recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security to lure Jensen Huang into a trap. That document circulated shortly before Trump’s visit to China in May. The tech company’s board of directors stated in a press release that it has no reason to believe that the company’s secrets or U.S. national security have been compromised. “Today’s news will not slow Nvidia,” said a spokesperson for the tech giant. “Jensen is committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption.” In its statement, the board of directors specifies that an independent committee, which will be supported by “outside independent counsel,” will conduct the investigation. historyItems.summary: 本週晚些時候，隨著冷空氣擴散到紐約州，而且一場正在發展的風暴可能會帶來雨雪，紐約人可能會在本週晚些時候感受到更明顯的冬天的味道。最新的預測並不支持稱其為全州範圍內的重大暴風雪。然而，國家氣象局目前正在監測本週稍後的一個系統，該系統可能會在紐約中部和東部較高海拔地區產生可測量的降雪。儘管預測仍不確定，但海拔較低的地區和沿海社區更有可能下​​雨。
historyItems.originalTitle: When will it snow in New York? Latest forecast shows late-week storm potential
historyItems.originalSummary: New Yorkers could get a more noticeable taste of winter late this week as colder air spreads into the state and a developing storm potentially brings rain and snow. The latest forecasts do not support calling this a major statewide snowstorm. However, the National Weather Service is now monitoring a late-week system that could produce measurable snow in higher elevations of central and eastern New York. Lower elevations and coastal communities are more likely to receive rain, although the forecast remains uncertain. Before that system arrives, much of the state will experience seasonable to relatively mild weather. Scattered rain showers will affect parts of upstate New York through Monday, followed by a period of quieter weather in many areas. Some snow could reach parts of New York late this week, but it is too early to determine where it will accumulate or whether the storm will become disruptive. The National Weather Service in Binghamton said a clipper-type system could move into the Ohio Valley Wednesday and Thursday before potentially helping form a coastal storm by Friday. The forecast includes chances for rain and snow Thursday and Friday, with some rain and snow showers potentially lingering into Saturday. Higher elevations would have the best chance of seeing measurable snow if the storm tracks south of the region, allowing colder air to become established. The Catskills and higher terrain of central New York are among the areas to watch. Uncertainty remains high because forecast models differ on the storm's track. Even relatively small changes could determine whether a location receives snow, a rain-snow mix or primarily rain. The National Weather Service's winter weather forecasts provide snowfall projections extending out to 72 hours, including expected accumulation and lower- and higher-end possibilities. Western New York will remain unsettled into Monday, but the precipitation is initially expected to fall as rain.

historyItems.summary: AST SpaceMobile（納斯達克GS：ASTS）計畫從 2028 年開始使用新型可重複使用的 Blacklift 火箭部署其 BlueBird 衛星星座。 Blacklift 發射系統是根據專門技術和引擎協議與 Firefly Aerospace 共同開發的。該公司的目標是透過將內部發射能力與其衛星平台結合，實現更獨立且具成本意識的進入軌道。 Blacklift 與 Firefly 的新合作夥伴關係僅反映了 AST SpaceMobile 更廣泛的資本和執行風險的一部分。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile announces new 'Blacklift' rocket, targets 2028 launch debut
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile (NasdaqGS:ASTS) plans to deploy its BlueBird satellite constellation using a new reusable Blacklift rocket starting in 2028. The Blacklift launch system is being developed with Firefly Aerospace under a dedicated technology and engine agreement. The company aims for more independent and cost-aware access to orbit by pairing in house launch capability with its satellite platform. The new Blacklift partnership with Firefly only captures part of the story around AST SpaceMobile's broader capital and execution risks. Check out 2 warning signs that AST SpaceMobile investors should know about. Space infrastructure tied to direct satellite connectivity and data processing spans far beyond a single player, so it is worth comparing this move against other beneficiaries of rising demand for orbital capacity and ground computing power through 52 AI infrastructure stocks .

historyItems.originalSummary: KLA Corporation reported fiscal first quarter 2027 revenue of US$4.14b and net income of US$1.55b, with GAAP diluted EPS of US$1.18 from continuing operations. We will now look at how KLA's strong quarter but pressured gross margins may reshape the investment narrative that investors focus on.

historyItems.originalTitle: Microsoft Winding Down Oracle Deal to Rent AI Cloud Capacity
historyItems.originalSummary: Microsoft is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle as part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.Oracle shares were down nearly 3% in afternoon trading, while Microsoft was little changed.Microsoft has been turning off rented computing capacity from Oracle in recent months after declining to renew the contract, according to the report.Over time, the computing capacity Microsoft was renting became less valuable as it no longer met the company's evolving needs, the report added.Microsoft and Oracle did not immediately respond to Reuters’ requests for comment.

historyItems.originalTitle: How Investors Are Reacting To Cisco Stock After Analyst Downgrade

historyItems.summary: AST SpaceMobile 將使用 Firefly 引擎建造自己的可重複使用 Blacklift 火箭，導致 Firefly 股價上漲 37%，而 AST 則達到 52 週低點。 Alphabet 持有約 900 萬股 A​​ST 股票，價值約 2.89 億美元，因為 AST 在季度虧損 2.31 億美元後面臨火箭般的成本和稀釋。 Firefly 的引擎交易金額高達 13 億美元，AST 預付了約 8 億美元的現金和股票，稀釋了現有股東的股權。 AST SpaceMobile（納斯達克股票代碼：ASTS）在 2026 年 11 月 6 日開盤前表示，將建造自己的火箭 Blacklift，以便於 2028 年底開始發射藍鳥衛星。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile To Build New Blacklift Rocket
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile will build its own reusable Blacklift rocket with Firefly engines, sending Firefly shares up 37% while AST hit a 52-week low. Alphabet held about 9 million AST shares, worth roughly $289 million, as AST takes on rocket costs and dilution after a $231 million quarterly loss. Firefly's engine deal tops $1.3 billion, with AST paying about $800 million upfront in cash and shares that dilute current holders. Before the open on November 6, 2026, AST SpaceMobile ( NASDAQ:ASTS ) said it will build its own rocket, Blacklift, to launch its BlueBird satellites starting in late 2028. Firefly Aerospace ( NASDAQ:FLY ) will supply the engines.
